purpose: Read-only compile of the exact XLSX pressure goal against the promoted library-backed capability registry.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
p=root/'canonical/runtime/goal_compiler.py'
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('gc',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
reg=json.loads((root/'canonical/runtime/BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.json').read_text())['capabilities']
mission=json.loads((root/'canonical/astra_runtime/missions/ASTRA_RUNTIME_VERIFIED_CAPABILITY_XLSX_002.json').read_text())
out=m.compile_goal(mission['goal'],reg,root)
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
print('XLSX_GOAL_COMPILED')
PY
